info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Parking Reservations Cancel-v1-spec
info.description: The Cancel Parking Reservations API allows users to efficiently manage their parking reservations by providing a straightforward mechanism to cancel existing bookings. This endpoint targets consumers, such as parking management systems and mobile apps, that require the ability to update reservation statuses in real-time. It ensures that users can free up their reserved parking spots and helps optimize space usage. Utilization of this API enhances user experience by offering flexibility in managing reservations.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel an existing reservation in the system. Ensure you provide the required reservation identifier to successfully cancel the reservation.

requestBody.description: Request to cancel a reservation. The body should contain the details necessary for cancellation, specifically identifying the reservation to be canceled.

DeleteParkingReservationsCancelRequest.description: The request body for canceling a reservation operation. This expects a string representation of the relevant data.

DeleteParkingReservationsCancelResponse_.title: Cancel Reservation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the reservation cancellation.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: An optional message providing additional information about the cancellation operation.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit for the cancellation operation.

DeleteParkingReservationsCancelResponse_.description: Schema representing the response for a successful cancellation of a reservation.
